n_jobs: <int> Number of jobs to be processed through the production line.
n_machines: <int> Number of machines arranged sequentially in the production line.
no_idle_machines: <list[int], length varies> Machines (1-indexed) designated as no-idle, where processing must be continuous with no gaps between consecutive jobs.
no_idle_flags: <list[bool], length n_machines> Whether each machine (0-indexed) is designated as no-idle, requiring continuous processing with no gaps between consecutive jobs.
processing_times: <list[list[int]], shape [n_jobs][n_machines]> Time required for each job to be processed on each machine.
